This list shows only the 10 combinations with digits in increasing order, not all possible 3-digit arrangements; it omits numbers such as 621 and 876, so it cannot be used to identify the true largest number.
For the largest possible number, arrange the three largest digits in descending order; for the smallest possible number, arrange the three smallest digits in ascending order, then subtract.
